snippet.title: Zen Coaching
snippet.description:
I am a master elo coach. I will be posting VODS/Coaching sessions regularly. Please share my videos if you find them helpful! 
You can add Zen#4641 on discord if you want to contact me.

Please note that: I am not affiliated with  the coach Tim "Zen" Stempihar, Splyce or Riot games in any in any way, shape, or form". 
I am strictly a private league of legends performance coach.
